stories.title: Travel Info Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate response schema for travel burden including distance, duration, origin, destination, units, and error states. Ensure compatibility with clinical trial location structures and Pydantic models.

stories.title: Core Travel Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement and harden _get_travel_info to call Google Routes API, compute distance and duration from user origin to each trial location, and support multiple locations per trial with aggregation or selection logic.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration
stories.description: Integrate travel burden outputs into evaluate_care_facade so each clinical trial result includes computed travel distance and duration fields in the response payload.

stories.title: Error Handling and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Implement resilient handling for Google Routes failures including timeouts, invalid/missing coordinates, and API errors. Ensure graceful degradation (omit or partially populate travel data without breaking trial results).

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden
stories.description: Develop unit tests for travel computation logic (distance, duration, multi-location handling) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow through evaluate_care_facade with mocked Google Routes responses.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for travel computation; must be added under Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests
